goal: Learn pivot tables and lookups well enough to build a monthly sales dashboard in Excel
interpretation: In 90 minutes of Hindi video, the learner can clean a sales list into a table, use XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP to pull in product or customer details, summarize sales with pivot tables, and assemble a one-page monthly sales dashboard with pivot charts and slicers.
assumptions: The learner has a sales list with date, product, customer, quantity and amount columns, and possibly a separate price or product master list for lookups.
Their Excel is a recent version (Microsoft 365 or 2019+) with XLOOKUP; VLOOKUP is covered as a fallback in case their version lacks it.
Hindi-language videos (Hinglish acceptable) are preferred, with on-screen Excel menus in English.
Viewing time only: the 90 minutes is spent watching, not practising.

sub_topics.title: Preparing sales data as an Excel Table
sub_topics.why: They can enter and sort data, but pivot tables and lookups work reliably only on clean, structured data; Tables auto-expand as new monthly sales are added.

sub_topics.title: VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP to fetch product/customer details
sub_topics.why: They only know basic formulas; lookups let them pull prices, categories or customer names from a master list into the sales sheet.

sub_topics.title: Creating pivot tables: rows, columns, values, summarizing sales
sub_topics.why: Core skill to total sales by month, product, and salesperson without writing formulas.

sub_topics.title: Grouping dates by month and calculating in pivots (sum, count, % of total)
sub_topics.why: A monthly dashboard needs sales grouped by month and share-of-total insights, which go beyond a basic pivot.

sub_topics.title: Pivot charts and slicers
sub_topics.why: Visuals and click-to-filter controls turn pivot summaries into an interactive dashboard; they extend the filtering they already know.

sub_topics.title: Building the monthly sales dashboard layout end to end
sub_topics.why: Brings lookups, pivots, charts and slicers together into one clean page with KPIs, which is their final goal.

warnings: Every candidate lacked a transcript. All picks rest on chapters, descriptions or titles, so confidence is low throughout. Skim the first minutes of each video to confirm it is in Hindi and matches your sales data before committing.

Gap: the 'Preparing data as an Excel Table' sub-topic (7 min) has no trustworthy video. The Hindi 'table' candidates appear to teach basic cell tables with borders and not Ctrl+T. Select your data, press Ctrl+T and tick 'My table has headers' yourself before starting the lookup and pivot videos.
The lookup segment (16:19-36:50) includes about 3 minutes of HLOOKUP that you can skip. You may skip VLOOKUP too if your Excel already has XLOOKUP (Microsoft 365 or 2021+).
The dashboard video builds from pivot tables only, so it will not show lookups in the dashboard. Use XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP to add product or customer columns to your sales table before creating the pivots.
